Dear Connections!!

The Constitution of India is more than the supreme law of the land; it is a commitment to justice, liberty, equality and fraternity.
As a legal professional, I firmly believe that understanding, respecting and upholding constitutional values is not merely a professional responsibility but a fundamental duty towards our nation.
Let us continue to strengthen the spirit of constitutionalism and the Rule of Law.
Happy Constitution Day!🇮🇳

#ConstitutionDay #IndianConstitution #RuleOfLaw #Justice #ConstitutionalValues #LegalProfession
